mapper.insert: insert into authorization_decisions(tenant_id,decision_id,permission_point,resource_type,resource_id,actor_type,actor_id,decision,reason_code,evaluated_scopes_json,correlation_id,decided_at) values(#{value.tenantId},#{value.decisionId},#{value.permissionPoint},#{value.resourceType},#{value.resourceId},#{value.actorType},#{value.actorId},#{value.decision},#{value.reasonCode},cast(#{value.evaluatedScopesJson} as jsonb),#{value.correlationId},#{value.decidedAt}) on conflict(tenant_id,decision_id) do nothing
mapper.select: select * from authorization_decisions where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and decision_id=#{decisionId}
mapper.insert: insert into audit_evidence(tenant_id,evidence_id,event_type,aggregate_type,aggregate_id,root_task_id,actor_type,actor_id,action,reason_code,audit_reason,correlation_id,causation_id,authorization_decision_id,request_id,client_address,payload_hash,outcome,evidence_json,occurred_at) values(#{value.tenantId},#{value.evidenceId},#{value.eventType},#{value.aggregateType},#{value.aggregateId},#{value.rootTaskId},#{value.actorType},#{value.actorId},#{value.action},#{value.reasonCode},#{value.auditReason},#{value.correlationId},#{value.causationId},#{value.authorizationDecisionId},#{value.requestId},#{value.clientAddress},#{value.payloadHash},#{value.outcome},cast(#{value.evidenceJson} as jsonb),#{value.occurredAt}) on conflict(tenant_id,evidence_id) do nothing
mapper.select: select * from audit_evidence where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and aggregate_type=#{aggregateType} and aggregate_id=#{aggregateId} order by occurred_at desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update api_mutation_receipts set status=#{value.status},response_hash=#{value.responseHash},result_resource_type=#{value.resultResourceType},result_resource_id=#{value.resultResourceId},result_version=#{value.resultVersion},sync_status=#{value.syncStatus},completed_at=#{value.completedAt} where tenant_id=#{value.tenantId} and receipt_id=#{value.receiptId}
mapper.select: select * from api_mutation_receipts where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and receipt_id=#{receiptId}
select * from api_mutation_receipts where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and request_method=#{requestMethod} and request_path=#{requestPath} and idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
